engineering.threat_condition: Integrity of an operational message may be lost
engineering.threat_scenario: A crafted message reaches the target through the exposed interface
engineering.objective: Preserve message integrity before operational use
engineering.requirement: The receiving function shall reject messages that fail authenticity verification
engineering.verification: Inject invalid and replayed messages and verify rejection
